name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back and your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs, keeping your torso upright.
image_prompt_scene: Standing tall with the barbell resting across the upper back behind the neck, held with both hands wide, feet hip-width apart.
